headerDisplay: Cadillac command switches reset off after each request and do not report vehicle state. Optional Find Car controls sound/cancel the horn and lights. Opt-in location presence creates Home/Work sensors; unavailable GPS never means away. Credentials stay in a private JSON file. Presence locations are stored in this Homebridge configuration and its backups.

vehicleName.title: Vehicle display name
vehicleName.description: Prefix for command and presence accessories. Changing this does not change accessory identifiers.

model.title: Vehicle model label
model.description: Display-only model label; it does not select the vehicle or prove compatibility.

credentialsFile.title: Private credentials file
credentialsFile.description: Explicit absolute path to a mode 0600 JSON file. Leave unset until configured; no controls are registered without it. Do not paste credentials into Homebridge config.

browserPath.title: Chromium installation directory
browserPath.description: Optional absolute override. Defaults to .cache/homebridge-cadillac-onstar/browsers under Homebridge storage. Browser downloads are for manual sign-in; Homebridge UI excludes .cache from backups.

accessoryUuidPrefix.title: Accessory identifier namespace
accessoryUuidPrefix.description: Advanced migration setting. Use the legacy namespace only with the documented cache ownership migration; this setting alone cannot migrate another plugin's cache. Keep it unchanged after pairing.

controls.title: Command controls
controls.description: Choose which controls appear in Apple Home. Turning a control off here removes its accessory; enabling it again restores the same accessory identifier.

findCar.title: Find Car and Stop Alert
findCar.description: Adds two momentary switches for sounding the horn/flashing the lights and cancelling the alert. Enable only if these commands work in your myCadillac app.

presence.title: Vehicle presence
presence.description: Vehicle location only; it does not establish whether people are home. Fresh confirmed crossings can trigger Home automations. Initial and recovered readings establish a baseline without publishing a crossing event.

enabled.title: Enable location polling
enabled.description: Off by default. Polling requests a vehicle location update through OnStar; its latency and availability vary.

pollIntervalSeconds.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollIntervalSeconds.description: Time between completed polls. All places share one location request. Errors back off automatically; a lower value does not guarantee fresher location.

maxLocationAgeSeconds.title: Maximum location age (seconds)
maxLocationAgeSeconds.description: Must be at least the polling interval. Older readings are unavailable and cannot trigger arrival/departure.

confirmationSamples.title: Distinct readings to confirm presence
confirmationSamples.description: Repeated copies of the same GPS fix do not count as new confirmations.

exposeSwitch.title: Show presence switch tiles too
exposeSwitch.description: Adds a status-only switch mirror for each sensor. Manual changes are rejected; tapping cannot change GPS presence.

locations.title: Named places
locations.description: Provide at least one place when enabled. Coordinates remain in your Homebridge config and backups; the plugin does not log them or retain trip history.

id.title: Stable place ID
id.description: Unique ID such as home or work. Keep it unchanged to preserve Home accessories and automations.

name.title: Place display name
name.description: For example Home or Work; defaults to the place ID.

departureRadiusMeters.title: Departure radius (metres)
departureRadiusMeters.description: Must exceed the arrival radius to prevent GPS drift from toggling presence.
